big_case.notes: Paid petition from the First Circuit raising doctrinal questions on whether Cedar Point per se takings reach trademarks and whether Puerto Rico possesses sovereign immunity or had it abrogated by the Lanham Act, attracting three amicus briefs and two relists before an unadorned denial.

leakage.notes: Forward prediction placed on 2026-10-14 before the 2026-11-09 denial. The only external fetch in retrieval_log.json was the pre-cutoff 2026-09-21 supplemental brief PDF from supremecourt.gov, which was disclosed in retrieval.md.

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records actual_disposition = 'denied' on 2026-11-09 after signals.distribution_count rose from 2 to 3 (redistributed November 2 for the November 6 conference).
central_claims.claim: The most likely outcome is denial after one or more further relists, rather than an immediate denial on October 16 with nothing else attached.

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records signals.cvsg_date = null; the Court denied certiorari without inviting the Solicitor General.
central_claims.claim: The Court is unlikely to call for the views of the Solicitor General (CVSG) despite petitioners' September 21 supplemental brief requesting one in the alternative.

central_claims.basis: outcome.json records noted_dissent_from_denial = false and the November 9 denial order included no separate opinion or statement.
central_claims.claim: The relist is driven by a chamber considering a dissent or statement respecting the denial (roughly 35% conditional probability) or weighing a narrow grant on Question 2.
